The Stonemaul Tribe is a group of Ogres residing at [[Dustwallow Marsh]].

==Notes and trivia==
* Although the faction had originally been announced in the notes for [[patch 1.16.0]], no content was ever developed for them and no NPCs were ever attributed to the faction.
